attempts.summary: Configured PostgreSQL 15 streaming replication across node1 (primary, writable) and node2/node3 (async streaming standbys, read-only). Installed PGDG + CentOS7 vault + EPEL7-archive repos to satisfy RHEL7 dependency gaps, initialized the primary, created a replicator role, opened firewalld port 5432, took pg_basebackup-based standbys with -R (auto standby.signal + primary_conninfo), and verified live replication of writes from primary to both standbys and read-only enforcement on standbys. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes (standbys first, primary last), proving changed boot IDs and full recovery of PostgreSQL service, replication streaming, and committed data on each node.
